D: Animated pieces set to classical music, from dancing mushrooms to a sorcerer's apprentice.
P: Serve the snacks when the little mushrooms start dancing.
S: the little mushrooms dancing in the Nutcracker Suite
Button mushrooms stuffed with garlic butter, breadcrumbs and parmesan, baked at 200C for 12 minutes.
Bacchus and the grape harvest in the Pastoral Symphony
Bunches of red and green grapes piled on a big platter with a wedge of brie, halved fresh figs and a little pot of honey for drizzling over the cheese.
the dancing hippos in the Dance of the Hours
Choux pastry with gruyère piped into small balls, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until puffed.
M: the Greek gods' afternoon on Olympus
Layers of fried eggplant and spiced lamb sauce under a thick golden béchamel. Slice 2 eggplants and fry or grill until golden.
the dinosaurs in the Rite of Spring
Lamb leg rubbed with garlic and rosemary, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes, with roast vegetables.
W: Meringue kisses baked at 100C for an hour, dusted with edible glitter and served with berries.
K: Sparkling grape juice or red wine served in goblets with frozen grapes.

s.note: the little mushrooms dancing in the Nutcracker Suite
s.how: Remove the stalks from 500g button mushrooms. Mix softened butter with crushed garlic, breadcrumbs, grated parmesan and chopped parsley. Press a spoonful into each mushroom cap and bake at 200C for 12 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve warm on a platter.

s.note: Bacchus and the grape harvest in the Pastoral Symphony
s.how: Wash bunches of red and green grapes and pile them on a big platter. Add a whole wedge of brie at room temperature and halve 6 fresh figs around it. Set a little pot of honey in the middle so everyone can drizzle it over the cheese and figs.

m.note: the Greek gods' afternoon on Olympus
m.how: Slice 2 eggplants and fry or grill until golden. Brown 600g lamb mince with an onion, cinnamon and 400g tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes. Layer in a dish, top with a béchamel of 60g butter, 60g flour, 600ml milk and an egg and bake at 180C for 40 minutes.

w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until thick and glossy. Pipe small kisses onto lined trays and bake at 100C for an hour. Cool in the oven, dust with edible glitter and serve with fresh raspberries.

d.how: Freeze a bunch of red grapes on a tray for 2 hours. Drop a few frozen grapes into each goblet in place of ice. Pour sparkling grape juice for the kids and red wine for the adults, so the grapes chill each glass without watering it down.
